capabilities: Pick folders with a List or Tree picker
Search filenames of non-Markdown files by extension
Review results in an expandable preview pane
Run as a pop-up modal or docked tab
extras: Installable via release ZIP, BRAT, or the community plugin listing; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search covers the whole vault, so finding notes in a specific folder or locating non-Markdown files by name requires filtering manually.
summary: Search modal or dockable tab that restricts search to user-selected folders and can also match filenames of non-Markdown files.
